# Nature recordings

These are field recordings bundled for offline playback. Sam’s Canvas has made no further edits to these audio files. Ambient music is synthesized separately by Sam’s Canvas.

| File | Recording / author | License | Loop preparation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| birds.ogg | [Birds — kvgarlic](https://freesound.org/people/kvgarlic/sounds/156826/) | [CC0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) | Porrumentzio / Blanket |
| wind.ogg | [Wind blowing in a field in Texas, USA — felix.blume](https://freesound.org/people/felix.blume/sounds/217506/) | [CC0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) | Porrumentzio / Blanket |
| stream.ogg | [Stream — gluckose](https://freesound.org/people/gluckose/sounds/333987/) | [CC0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) | Original |
| rain.ogg | [rain ambience — alex36917](https://freesound.org/people/alex36917/sounds/524605/) | [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) | Porrumentzio / Blanket |

Bundled files obtained from [Blanket's sound collection](https://github.com/rafaelmardojai/blanket/tree/master/data/resources/sounds). Its [licensing manifest](https://github.com/rafaelmardojai/blanket/blob/master/SOUNDS_LICENSING.md) identifies the source recordings, authors, licenses, and editors. Credits are also shown inside the mixer.
